name: Point Cloud to Occupancy Grid Conversion with Camera FOV Filtering
definition: A method to convert a Velodyne point cloud into a 3D occupancy grid, filtering points based on the camera's Field of View (FOV) and projecting them into grid coordinates.
summary: This method converts LiDAR data into a 3D occupancy grid by strictly filtering points within the camera's field of view, ensuring alignment with the visual sensor's perspective.
